Fighter: The quarry shut the day the levy came. I kept the axe. Seemed only fair.
Twelve years felling pine. Soldiers can't be harder. They dodge, you say? Rude.
The levy took my brother east. You're heading east. That's the whole plan.
Point me at something to hit.
My foreman said I'd never be more than a strong back. Watch this strong back.
I bet a month's pay you'd reach the capital. Can't let you lose my money.
Archer: I owed the crown a quiver this season. Thought I'd deliver it by hand.
My father shot for the levy, and his mother before him. Tradition. Here I am.
I don't miss. Point me at a target.
Somebody burned my orchard. I'd like a word with them, from about eighty paces.
I hunted rabbits for the lord's table. The lord's gone. The rabbits can rest.
The border wardens turned me down. Too chatty, they said. I'll show them. Loudly.
Mage: Expelled for reading past chapter nine. Chapter ten is mostly fire. You'll like it.
The academy burned down. Not my fault. Mostly. I need somewhere else to practice.
My teacher went to the capital to ask a question and never came back. I'll ask louder.
They taught me fire at seven and never said where the words come from. I'm asking now.
Tutoring rich children paid well. Then the rich children were drafted. So.
Please don't stand directly in front of me. Or behind me, on bad days.
Cavalier: I swore an oath nobody asks riders to take anymore. I'll keep it with you instead.
The garrison says I stole this mount. Her dam was my family's. They can argue it.
I rode dispatches for a captain who stopped writing back. I'd like new orders.
The empire kept the drills and dropped the oaths. I kept both. Lucky you.
Mount's fed, lance is sharp, and I've nowhere else to ride. Lead on.
Cleric: I can mend what's broken. Stay close.
The temple sent every staff out after the levies. I'm late. I'm sorry.
I've buried more than I've mended this year. I'd like to reverse that.
Don't thank me. Just stop standing where the arrows are.
My abbess said the light goes where it's needed. It's needed rather badly here.
I ran the village infirmary alone. You lot at least march in one direction.
Myrmidon: The sword school paid my debt. I work it off in duels. I'd rather duel the empire.
My master said I wasn't ready. My master was also late to every fight for forty years.
I'm hunting the duelist who crippled my teacher. Until I find them, I'm yours.
Quick feet, a sharp blade, and a debt of thirty silver. Two out of three is good.
I've drilled the same cut ten thousand times. I'd like to use it once.
Thief: Locks, traps, pockets - I handle them all.
Your camp's cooking beats the jail's. That's my entire reasoning.
I lifted your quartermaster's purse and gave it back. Consider that my interview.
I stole a magistrate's signet. The magistrate wants it back. I want an army nearby.
Locks got cheap when the war started. What they guard didn't. Funny, that.
I go where I please. Right now, I please to go with you.
Mercenary: Coin's good. Cause is better. You've got both.
My last contract ended when my employer did. Your terms can't be worse.
Half pay now, half when we win. If we lose, I'll invoice the grave.
Fought for the empire last spring. They paid in scrip. You pay in silver, I hope?
Twelve years a sellsword. Never once worked for anyone who said please. You did.
Don't expect loyalty. Expect punctuality and a clean edge. Loyalty costs extra.
Pegasus Knight: My mount landed beside your camp and won't leave. So, apparently, we're joining.
The legion grounded me for insubordination. The sky didn't.
From above, I've seen what the corruption does.
I carried letters over the ridges until there was no one left to write to.
She chose me over a captain's heir. I've been trying to deserve it ever since.
My sister flies dispatches in the capital. I mean to get there before her news does.
Knight: I am the shield. You are the sword.
The levy put me on a wall. The wall fell. I didn't. So here I am.
This armor weighs as much as my cousin. My cousin complains more.
Nobody runs from a charge in full plate. You physically can't. I think that's the idea.
Twenty years guarding one gate. The gate's gone. The habit isn't.
Go on ahead. I'll catch up. Sometime tonight.
Dancer: A dance can turn the tide. Watch and see.
I danced for a garrison every night for a year. None of them marched home. Yours will.
The troupe split up at the border. I kept the shoes and most of the songs.
Soldiers forget what they're marching back to. I'm the reminder.
Your people tipped best at the crossroads tavern last night. Easy choice, really.
My grandmother danced for kings. I dance for whoever's still breathing.
Wyvern Rider: My wyvern and I answer to no lord. But for this fight - we'll make an exception.
My clan sold three wyverns to the empire. Consider me the refund.
My wyvern ate a tax collector's hat. We had to leave the mountains rather quickly.
The elders said stay out of lowland wars. The elders don't ride my wyvern.
Clan law says never fly for a banner. I'm flying beside one. Different thing.
She hatched the winter my mother died. We've looked after each other since.
Hero: Another war. Let's end this one.
The soldiers gave me the title. Command never did. I'd like to earn it twice.
I've buried two captains and a royal standard. I'd prefer not to bury you.
I was retired. The war wasn't. So here we both are.
They say I held a bridge alone. There were four of us. I'm the one they remember.
Somebody has to walk in front. I've had the practice.
Falcon Knight: Lance and sky. That's all I need.
I flew escort for the commission's seers. None of them saw this. Maybe yours does.
The high commission disbanded. My mount never got the letter.
Outflew three storms last month. The fourth one's on the ground. Let's go.
From above, the fens look like an old bruise. I'd rather not watch it spread.
I've landed where hope was thinnest for years. This is thinner. Good.
Sage: The old magic is failing. Perhaps your seer can show us a better path.
The library ends at a locked door. I'd like to read past it before it reads me.
They made me a sage so they wouldn't have to admit they'd nothing left to teach me.
I've read the liturgy's last pages. I would very much like to be wrong about them.
Forty years of study. I'd planned to retire to a warm chair. The chair burned.
Do keep the young ones away from my notes. Page forty bites.
Assassin: I don't do speeches. Just tell me who dies.
The empire paid me off the books. Then it closed the books, with me inside.
My last contract was you. I read the file and tore up the contract.
I've never appeared in a ledger. Don't start one on my account.
Someone in the capital owes me a name. I'll collect on the way.
Put me on the roster if you must. Don't expect me at roll call.
Sniper: Every wall kept one of us. My wall fell. Now I need a new wall.
I see the target. That's enough.
The garrison pretended not to know my name. You can too. It's easier.
Won the provincial shoot three years running. The prize was a conscription notice.
I've counted every shot I fired this war. I'd like the count to mean something.
Tell me the distance and the wind. Don't tell me the name.
Bishop: The light fades, but it hasn't gone. Not yet.
The temple gave me mercy and judgment both. I've used up the mercy this year.
My cathedral is a stable now. The horses seem devout enough.
I've heard ten thousand confessions. Yours will be the dullest. Congratulations.
The bishops who fled to the capital left me the keys. I mean to return them.
Pray if it helps. Duck if it doesn't. I'll see to the rest.
Chevalier: My lance rides where honor demands. Lead, and I follow.
A knight without a charge is nothing. Give me one.
Bred for distance, my mount and I both. Just tell me how far.
Sky Lancer: The wind answers to no one. Neither do I.
From up here, I see everything. Point me at the real threat.
I fly alone. Today alone looks like your whole army. Fine.
Sentinel: I don't move. I don't flinch. Come at me.
They'll break against me like waves on stone.
Put me wherever it's worst. Then stop worrying about it.
Paladin: I recite the oath whole, including the parts they cut. Someone ought to.
Three campaigns, two mounts, one oath. The oath has held up best.
The strong serve the weak. That's the line they struck. I'm putting it back.
My order sent me to hold a province. The province left. I'm still holding.
I trained your cavalry's instructors. They weren't listening. Perhaps you will.
I promised my father's grave I'd ride under a true banner once. Yours will do.
Warrior: Everyone in my unit died but me. They promoted me for it. I'd like to earn it.
Bigger axe, same problems. Point me at them.
Quarryman, then levy, then survivor. Now I'm whatever this is.
The berserk school sent me a letter. I used it to light a fire. I keep my own temper.
I bet your quartermaster I could lift the supply wagon. Lost. I owe you a season.
I don't retreat. My knees don't bend that way anymore.
Wyvern Lord: My wyvern's shadow settles arguments. You look like you've got a few.
The clans crown no kings. Good. I've no patience for bowing.
My clan voted to stay out of it. I lost the vote and took the biggest wyvern.
The empire offered a fortune for my mount. I answered from altitude.
Something stirs under the fens and my wyvern won't eat. I'd like to know why.
Twenty winters on the mountain. I came down because the smoke wouldn't stop rising.

Rowan: My lance is blessed. My aim? That's all me.
Astrid: The sky sees what the ground misses. I'll be your sight.

act1: The air tastes of iron here.
Scouts spotted movement ahead.
The ground is scarred from old battles.
The quarry roads are empty. The levies took even the picks to war.
Half the blades dug from this ground still carry Varen's mark.
Scout's report: six at the ford, poorly shod, well armed. Quarry picks, mostly.
Sign nailed to the mile post: LEVY BY ORDER. Someone has scratched beneath it: AGAIN.
'Whose side are they on?' 'Their own. Same as everyone this side of the river.'
act2: Imperial banners hang in tatters.
The corruption has touched this place.
Old fortifications, hastily rebuilt.
The old kingdom's roads run straight and true. The tolls are the empire's.
This province feeds the war economy a cartload at a time.
Toll-house ledger, last entry: Soldiers, forty. Paid, none. Toll-keeper, departed.
The mile markers count down to the capital. Someone has scratched out the numbers.
Camp talk: the garrison here hasn't been paid since the thaw. They'll be cranky.
act3: The sky darkens without clouds.
Reality bends at the edges here.
The earth hums with a low, wrong note.
The fens drain from the sacred ground. They always have.
The seers' liturgy names this place. The last pages are about it.
Scout's report: water's black past the reeds and the frogs have gone quiet. Don't drink.
A shrine post, its prayer board blank. The paint didn't fade. The words did.
'Didn't we fight here already?' 'Don't start that again.'
act4: The air itself resists each step.
This land remembers what was done to it.
The corruption runs deep here. Deeper than roots.
The court circle's seals are on every door.
These walls were raised to keep something in.
Posted on the gate: CURFEW AT DUSK. Beneath it, older and faded: CURFEW AT NOON.
The capital's streets are swept clean. Nobody is left to dirty them.
Quartermaster's note: arrows, low. Rations, lower. Morale, don't ask.
finalBoss: The end of the path. One way or another.
Everything converges here.
No more detours. No more preparation.
Every timeline the seers have walked passes through this floor.
Carved into the stair, very old: WE CAME THIS FAR ALSO.
No scout returns from below. The last one's lantern still burns on the steps.
'Any orders?' 'Same as always. Everyone walks back up.'

act1: A stronger presence guards this road.
The scouts fell back. That's never good.
The usual patrols don't come this way.
Scout's report: this lot marches in step. Somebody trained them properly.
Wanted poster on the mill door. The reward's been raised twice this month.
'The wardens won't go that way.' 'Why not?' 'Ask them. They won't say.'
act2: An officer commands these troops. Stay sharp.
Imperial elites. Not conscripts — true believers.
This garrison was reinforced recently.
Requisition slip found in the mud: One captain, veteran. Delivered.
The pickets salute each other here. Bad sign. It means someone's in charge.
Tavern rumor: the officer here has never lost a duel, and keeps the loser's gloves.
act3: The corruption has champions of its own.
Whatever guards this place has forgotten mercy.
The air crackles. Not lightning — something older.
The reed-cutters won't cross this ground. They leave offerings at the edge instead.
Scout's report: one of them walked through the bog and didn't sink. Didn't even try to.
A priest's aside: whatever holds this ground once prayed. It has forgotten how.
act4: A fragment of the emperor's will, given form.
This one was shaped by the ritual itself.
Even the ground trembles at what waits ahead.
Palace guard roster, one name circled in red ink: DO NOT ENGAGE ALONE.
The household knights still wear their parade plate. It's been reforged for war.
Overheard at the barricade: 'That one doesn't sleep. I've watched it not sleep.'
finalBoss: All that power, concentrated in one vessel.
This is the price of the final step.
It knows why we've come.
Its armor bears every standard the empire ever took, stacked like trophies.
Carved on the threshold in a seer's hand: IT REMEMBERS YOU. BE QUICKER.
'How many times have we done this?' 'Once. Just the once. Keep walking.'

act1: A commander holds the line ahead.
Steel and discipline guard this crossing.
Their leader won't yield ground easily.
The garrison captain's banner flies over the quarry works, freshly mended.
Scout's report: the captain eats with the troops. They'll fight hard for that one.
Tacked to the bridge post: CROSSING CLOSED BY ORDER OF THE MARCH. Signed in iron.
act2: The lieutenant's chosen blocks our path.
This one answers directly to the throne.
Command tents and war banners. A true siege.
The governor fled the province. The general stayed, and the general is worse.
Supply wagons circled three deep. Someone means to wait us out.
Camp talk: the Lieutenant sent this one a letter. It said only: HOLD.
act3: The ritual's guardian manifests.
The corruption's vessel awaits us.
Something presses against the edge of perception.
The shrine bells ring on their own out here. Twice, then silence. Then twice.
Scout's report: something big breathes under the fen. The water rises when it does.
In the liturgy's margin, in a shaking hand: do not wake it to kill it.
act4: The emperor's inner circle. The last wall.
This is what the ritual was building toward.
Beyond this, only the emperor himself.
The throne-room doors stand open. They have not been closed in a month.
Palace steward's list: Guests expected, one army. Chairs set out, one.
'They're waiting for us.' 'Longer than we think. Look at the dust.'
finalBoss: The source of everything. Right here.
No visions needed to see what comes next.
The world's fate rests on what happens here.
Below the capital the stone is warm, and the warmth has a pulse.
The seers' notes end mid-sentence here. In every copy they ever made.
Carved above the last door: WHAT SLEEPS HERE WAS NOT MEANT TO BE FED.

act1: Someone signals from the roadside.
A survivor. Still willing to fight.
Not everyone has given up on this land.
A quarryman flags you down with a hammer. A friendly wave. Probably.
Notice on the chapel door: WILLING HANDS WANTED. Someone has already signed it.
'You with the banner?' 'Depends who's asking.' 'Someone tired of hiding.'
act2: A deserter from the imperial ranks.
They've seen what the empire really is.
One more soul choosing the harder path.
Chalked on a milestone: IMPERIAL PAY OWED TO BEARER. The bearer waits nearby.
A figure at the crossroads, uniform turned inside out. Clever, if not subtle.
Camp gossip: someone's been following the column for two days, keeping pace.
act3: Even here, someone still resists.
A fighter, hardened by what they've survived.
They don't need convincing. They need a direction.
Smoke from one chimney in a drowned village. Someone is still cooking.
Scout's report: one survivor. Well armed, poorly fed, very annoyed.
A reed boat drifts out of the mist carrying one passenger and far too many weapons.
act4: To still fight, this deep in — that's something.
The corruption spat this one out. Their loss.
Another who refused to break.
A cellar door in the capital, knocked on thrice. It opens. Someone was waiting.
Chalked on an alley wall: STILL HERE. An arrow points down the alley.
'You the ones from the border?' 'What's left of us.' 'Good. I'm what's left too.'
finalBoss: One last warrior, drawn to the final stand.
They know the odds. They came anyway.
Some debts can only be paid in battle.
Footsteps on the stair behind you. Friendly ones, for once.
'I dreamt you'd come this way. Thought I ought to be here when you did.'
Someone has been camped on the landing a long while. Their fire is still lit.

Edric: The banner is yours now. Keep them together.
This is as far as I march. Carry it the rest of the way, {commander}.
Don't look back. The army follows you now.
Kira: I found the winning line... just not for me.
Don't stop. The path is still there. I can almost see it.
Heh. Thought I'd be the last one standing.
Voss: Still standing... for now. Go. Finish this.
Took more than I expected. Don't waste what's left.
The shield breaks so the sword can strike. Go.
Sera: The visions are fading... but I see you, {commander}. You'll find the way.
I couldn't see this path. Maybe that means it's the right one.
The future isn't written yet. Not even I could see this far.
Rowan: My lance... it's blessed. Take it. It'll know your hand.
The sky was beautiful from up there. Keep looking up.
One last charge. Make it count for both of us.
Astrid: I could see so far from up there... not far enough, it seems.
The wind carries on. So should you.
Don't look down. I never did.
Cael: The line holds. Even without me, the line holds.
I said I'd hold. And I did. Now go.
Every wall falls eventually. Build a better one.

act1: The light returns to their eyes, slowly.
Breath returns. The wound remembers.
The village chaplain asks no fee and apologizes for the draft.
Chalked on the chapel door: ONE RETURN PER SOUL PER SEASON. SEASON NEGOTIABLE.
A priest's aside: 'Breathe. Good. Now remember who you are. Take your time.'
act2: Pulled back from the edge. Not gently.
The old prayers still carry weight here.
The roadside shrine asks only a copper and a name. It keeps both.
'Coughing is normal. So is the taste of copper. So is weeping. Sit down.'
Offering box, carved lid: FOR THE LIGHT. Beneath, smaller: AND THE ROOF.
act3: Revival feels different now. Heavier.
The corruption makes the healing harder.
The fen priest works by candle, and the flame keeps leaning toward the water.
'They came back. Something else nearly did too. Don't tell them that.'
Triage note pinned to the altar: Returned, one. Asks for their mother. Let them.
act4: The altar burns brighter, as if in defiance.
Brought back in spite of everything.
A cathedral with no roof and one priest, who has not stopped praying in a week.
'Welcome back. The capital's worse than when you left, ten minutes ago.'
The priest writes the name in the book of returns. The book is nearly full.
finalBoss: One more miracle. Perhaps the last.
Restoration, at the world's end.
The last altar, lit by one lamp someone keeps refilling. Nobody sees who.
A tired healer's prayer: once more, and then once more after that.
'I remember doing this for you before,' says the priest. 'I'm sure I don't.'

act1: Growth, earned in blood and resolve.
The change is visible. Sharper. Stronger.
The temple clerk updates the roster in careful ink and blots it twice.
Drill sergeant's verdict: 'New title. Same feet. Pick them up.'
The old insignia goes in the offering box. It is full of old insignia.
act2: The battlefield has forged something new.
Ready for what lies ahead. Almost.
The old title falls away. A new one fits better.
The provincial seal is stamped, then stamped again for luck.
'Stand straighter. No, straighter. There. That's what a rank looks like.'
Letter home, unsent: They made me something new today. It fits better than the boots.
act3: Transformation. Not gentle, but necessary.
Stronger now. The corruption demands it.
The fen priest anoints with the last clean oil. Whatever's in the rest, not today.
'Promoted in a swamp. Tell it better when you're old.'
The change settles like a new coat of mail: heavy at first, then suddenly not.
act4: Even the altar seems impressed.
The power to face what's coming. Finally.
The capital's heraldry office is ash. The priest draws the new crest in chalk.
'Congratulations. The pay is the same. The pay is also nothing.'
Someone rings the cathedral bell for them. It has a crack and rings anyway.
finalBoss: Everything they were, refined to a point.
One last evolution. Make it matter.
No clerk, no ledger, no ceremony. Just the altar, and it will do.
A priest's aside: 'Most never got this far to be changed. Make it count for them.'
The last rank anyone will ever grant them, and they know it.

act1: The merchant eyes your coin purse hopefully.
Frontier goods. Honest prices. Mostly.
Painted on the cart: HAGEN, GOODS. NO CREDIT. NO LEVY SCRIP. NO HAGGLING BEFORE NOON.
'Iron's iron, friend. Varen's mark costs extra, and it's worth it.'
'Vulneraries, fresh this week. Well. This month. Smell fine to me.'
act2: Imperial supply lines make for good scavenging.
War is terrible for everything except business.
'Army surplus. Don't ask which army. The answer's the same either way.'
The merchant's ledger has two columns: Paid, and Deceased. The second is longer.
'Tolls cost me a fortune on these roads. So, naturally, they cost you one too.'
act3: The wares have a strange shimmer to them here.
Even merchants feel the corruption. The prices reflect it.
'Fen-dried herbs, very potent. Don't ask why they glow. I don't.'
The merchant poles a barge of goods through the reeds, humming a hymn off-key.
'Hagen's the name. Seen me before? Everyone has. I get around.'
act4: How this merchant survives here is its own mystery.
Rare goods, for those who've made it this far.
Old Hagen again, ahead of you as ever, stock fresh. Nobody saw the cart pass.
'Drowned in the fen, I did. Twice, I think. Still open every day but feast days.'
'Capital prices, friend. Everything's dearer when the capital's on fire.'
finalBoss: Last chance to prepare. Choose wisely.
The merchant's hands tremble as they lay out the wares.
Hagen has set up on the last stair. 'Where else would I be? You're buying.'
'Last sale of the season. Or the world. Either way, no refunds.'
'Sold to you before, you know. Many times. You always buy the same things.'

act1: The stronger ones fall. The road opens.
That was no ordinary patrol.
Scout's report: the rest of the patrol ran. They'll tell the next one about us.
The captain's gloves are good leather. Someone claims them before the dust settles.
'Were they supposed to be the hard ones?' 'Yes.' 'Oh. Good.'
act2: The empire's best, and it wasn't enough.
Their commander fell. The rest will scatter.
Casualty roll, imperial side: one officer. The rank is struck through by nightfall.
The garrison flag comes down. Nobody in the village cheers. Everyone watches.
Camp talk: that one had a reputation. Now it's ours.
act3: The corruption's champion is broken.
Power like that, and still it fell.
The reeds stand straight again where it fell. The water clears, a little.
A priest's aside: 'Burn it. Pray over the ash. Then burn the ash.'
'Did it scream?' 'It sang. I'd rather it had screamed.'
act4: The emperor's inner guard, shattered.
That was a fragment of his will. Now it's dust.
Another name struck from the palace roster. The clerk's ink is running out.
Barricade graffiti, still wet: THEY BLEED. PASS IT ON.
The household knight's crest is older than the empire. It goes into the baggage.
finalBoss: Nothing stands between us and the end now.
The final guardian falls.
The stair ahead is clear. The silence behind is worse.
'Is that the last of them?' 'The last before the last.'
Scratched beside the fallen guardian, fresh: NOT THIS TIME.

earnest.label: Earnest

normal: I'm getting better. I can feel it. Thank you for the chance.
Did you see that? I'll keep at it, I promise.
Every drill paid off. Thank you for trusting me out there.
A little stronger, a little surer. I won't let you down, {leader}.
I'll write home about today. Well, I will, once I find ink.
Whoever showed me that parry, I owe them supper.
I think I finally understand what the veterans meant.
Better than yesterday. That's all I ask of myself.
I'm grateful. Truly. Point me wherever I'm needed.
Still learning. Always learning. Gladly.
perfect: Everything came together at once! I don't even know who to thank first.
I feel ready for anything. Anything! Well... most things.
All those cold mornings, and look. Thank you, all of you.
Is this what it feels like to be good at something?
blank: Not much today. That's all right. I'll work twice as hard.
A slow step is still a step forward. I'll keep going.
Sorry. I'll do better next time, I swear it.
I'll ask the veterans what I'm doing wrong. Tonight.

fallen: Tell them... I tried my best. I really did.
Thank you... for letting me march with you.
I'm sorry... I wanted to see the end with you.
Don't stop on my account. Please. Keep going.

wry.label: Wry

normal: Look at that. Improvement. Someone alert the chroniclers.
Stronger, apparently. My knees have not been informed.
Don't get used to it. I certainly won't.
One more good day and I'll start expecting them.
Well. A pleasant surprise. I distrust those.
Progress. Mind you, the bar was lying on the floor.
A little better. The enemy remains unimpressed, I'm sure.
I'd celebrate, but someone would make me carry the barrel.
Growth. The war's one reliable kindness, apparently.
Better at killing. Another thing I'll have to explain to my mother.
perfect: Everything improved at once. Something terrible must be coming.
Flawless. I'll be insufferable for a week. Two, if we win.
Remind me of this day when I'm face-down in a ditch.
Suspiciously good. Who did I bribe?
blank: Ah. Well. Consistency is its own reward.
Nothing. Good. I'd hate to peak too early.
I'm saving my improvement for a special occasion.
Growing at the pace of a glacier. A dignified glacier.

fallen: Well. That's inconvenient.
Should've taken my own advice. Never did.
Tell them I went out with a clever remark. Make one up.
Huh. Thought I'd be more surprised.

grim.label: Grim

normal: Stronger. Doesn't change the arithmetic.
Good. One more day I don't die.
Harder to kill. That's all it means.
The ground's still waiting. It can wait longer.
I've buried better. I'll try not to join them.
Noted. Now move.
Lived long enough to learn something. Rare enough.
Still here. Still learning. Neither lasts.
Scars teach. I've had a lot of teachers.
It'll help. Until it doesn't.
perfect: All of it, at once. Fate's fattening me up for something.
Everything sharper. Means something worse is coming.
Good day. Don't trust good days.
Strong as I'll ever be. Remember that when you bury me.
blank: Nothing. Figures.
Same as yesterday. Same as tomorrow.
Didn't expect more. Wasn't disappointed.
The war takes more than it gives. Always has.

fallen: Knew it'd be today.
Finally. Some rest.
Don't waste time on me. Move.
Put me with the others. It's fine.

proud.label: Proud

normal: Of course. Did anyone doubt it? Don't answer.
Magnificent, if I say so myself. And I do.
Someone write this down. For posterity.
Better and better. It's almost unfair to the enemy.
Watch closely. You may learn something.
They'll sing about me. Perhaps not well, but loudly.
I improve. It's what I do. Among many other things.
Try to keep up, {leader}. I'm only getting started.
A fine day's work. Mine, specifically.
Any better and I'd need a statue. Two, for balance.
perfect: Perfection. At last the world sees what I've seen all along.
Flawless. Commission the portrait. Both profiles.
Every inch improved. Every inch! Somebody faint, please.
Fetch a bard. No, fetch three. This needs harmony.
blank: Hm. The world wasn't ready for more of me today.
A rest day. Even legends pace themselves.
Clearly I was already at my peak. There's nowhere to go.
We will not speak of this. Ever.

fallen: This... was not in the song.
Remember me taller than I was. And undefeated.
Impossible. I was... magnificent.
Carve it deep. {name}. Big letters.

nervous.label: Nervous

normal: I'm alive! Oh. And stronger? Both? Good. Good.
Did that just happen? I think that just happened.
Please don't expect this every time. I certainly don't.
Stronger. Still terrified, but stronger.
I didn't die! That's two good things today.
Oh no. Now they'll expect more of me.
My hands have almost stopped shaking. Almost.
Was that me? That can't have been me.
I'll try not to faint about it. No promises.
Is it bad luck to notice? Forget I noticed.
perfect: Everything? All at once? Something must be about to eat me.
This is too much good news. I need to sit down.
I feel... capable? That's frightening in a whole new way.
Nobody look at me or it'll all go away.
blank: Figured. Honestly, that's almost a relief.
Nothing? Oh, thank goodness. No one will expect anything.
At least I'm consistent. Consistently... this.
I knew it. I knew it. I'm so sorry.

fallen: I knew... I knew this would happen.
Oh. It doesn't even hurt. Why doesn't it hurt?
I was scared the whole time. I stayed anyway. Tell them that.
Not now... I was only just getting brave...

devout.label: Devout

normal: Grace given. I'll spend it well.
She has no name left to thank, so I thank her in deeds.
A small mercy. I'll carry it where it's needed.
Every strength is borrowed. I'll return it with interest.
The prayer was answered. It usually is, just quietly.
I asked for steadiness, not glory. She listened.
Blessed be the hand that shapes us. It is shaping me still.
Another dawn's worth of strength. I won't waste the light.
The shrines stand empty, but the grace does not.
May I be worthy of it, {leader}. May we both be.
perfect: Grace poured out, all at once. What is she asking of me?
A full cup. I had forgotten how heavy blessings are.
Every prayer answered in one breath. I am humbled.
She spent her name for us. Today she spent a little more.
blank: Lean days teach patience. I'll keep praying.
Not every prayer is answered. Every prayer is heard.
Grace is not owed. I'll kneel and try again.
She gives what's needed. Perhaps I needed humility.

fallen: I go to her... she won't need a name to find me.
Keep the vigil for me... just one candle.
Grace... I can feel it... it's warm.
Forgive me... I wasn't finished praying.

mercenary.label: Mercenary

normal: Better at the job. I expect the wages to notice.
Stronger. That's a raise in any honest outfit.
Skill's the only thing in this war that holds its value.
I'll add this to my rate. Starting now.
Good investment, keeping me alive. Keep at it.
Every lesson paid for in blood. Mine. I'm billing someone.
More worth per coin than anyone in this camp. Just saying.
Worth more today than yesterday. Remember that at payday, {leader}.
Sharper. Doesn't come free. Nothing does.
Profit's profit. Even when it's just breathing.
perfect: Everything went up. Everything. Now so does my fee.
That's a bonus if I ever saw one. Pay accordingly.
Best deal I've made all war, and I made it with myself.
At this rate you won't afford me. Enjoy me while you can.
blank: Bad trade today. Can't win every bargain.
Nothing? I'll overlook it. The fee stays the same.
Some days you're paid in coppers. Keep marching.
Don't tell the paymaster about this one.

fallen: Keep my wages... buy the company a round...
Should have asked for more coin... up front.
Worst contract I ever signed. Best company, though.
Send what's owed to my sister. The address is in my boot.

dreamer.label: Dreamer

normal: Something in me unfolded, like a letter left out in the rain.
I dreamed I'd grow today. I dream a lot of things, though.
Did the clouds shift just then? Or was that me?
There's a tune in my head I've never heard before.
I feel taller. Not in body. Somewhere else.
The river back home would have liked to see this.
Each day I'm less who I was. I hope home still knows me.
I think the crows noticed. They nodded. Crows do that.
If I can change this fast, maybe the world can too.
Someday I'll tell the stars, and they'll pretend to be surprised.
perfect: Everything bloomed at once, like a meadow in a single morning.
I feel like a lantern someone finally remembered to light.
The whole sky must have leaned down to help.
If only the orchard back home could see me now.
blank: A quiet day. Seeds sleep before they sprout.
Nothing grew. Winter is only a pause, I think.
I was watching a moth. I think I missed my chance.
Some days the wind just passes through.

fallen: It's so quiet... like the hills at home.
I can see the stars... they're closer than I thought.
Take me home... the long way... past the river...
I dreamed this once... it ended differently.

normal: Quicker. I felt the air split a hair earlier that time.
My old master said the blade learns before the hand. The hand is catching up.
Another notch toward paying off the sword school. Maybe two.
Faster feet, same thin skin. I'll take the trade.
I drew, cut, and sheathed before I finished the thought. Good.
One more lesson carved into me. The school never taught gently.
Keep the fights short, {leader}, and I'll keep getting better at them.
perfect: Every part of me sharpened at once. My masters never saw a day like this.
Faster, stronger, harder to kill. I'm almost worried about who I'm becoming.
I should write to the school, {leader}. They'd call me a liar and ask for the debt.
blank: The blade was faster today. I wasn't. Tomorrow, then.
A swordsman polishes one cut ten thousand times. This was one of those times.
Nothing? Fine. Speed was never something you could hurry.

fallen: Too slow... just once. That's all it takes.
Tell the school... the debt's paid.
I always said... one clean hit would do it.

normal: The armor feels lighter. It isn't. I'm just getting stronger inside it.
Let them come. I'm harder to dent than I was this morning.
Another dent hammered out, another one earned. That's the job.
They levied me to stand still. Turns out I have a gift for it.
Stronger arms, same slow legs. The lance reaches; I'll let it.
The smith will need a bigger breastplate. Or a smaller me. Unlikely.
Hold the line, they said. I've been holding it harder every day, {leader}.
perfect: Wait. Did I just get faster? In this armor? Someone fetch a priest.
Everything, even my feet. {leader}, I'm going to be insufferable about this.
Stronger, sturdier, quicker. The whole suit finally feels like it fits me.
blank: Nothing new. But nothing got through, either. I'll call it even.
Still slow. Still standing. Some would call that consistency.
The armor didn't improve, but I polished it. That counts, surely.

fallen: Didn't move... not one step. Tell them.
Heavy... so heavy. Help me sit down.
Guess the wall had a gap after all.

normal: Swung like a felling cut that time. Clean through, one stroke.
Back at the camp we'd call that a good day's timber.
Arms feel like fresh-split oak. Point me at something, {leader}.
Still can't aim for beans, but I'm hitting harder when I do.
The quarry never paid this well, and the rocks never swung back.
Every scar's a lesson. I've been a very good student lately.
An axe doesn't care about clever. Lucky me, I'm getting strong instead.
perfect: Even my luck turned up. First time for everything, eh?
Stronger, steadier, sharper eyes. The foreman wouldn't know me.
Everything grew. I'm checking my axe for a curse.
blank: Swung hard, learned nothing. Sounds like my whole apprenticeship.
Same arms, same axe. The trees never complained.
Nothing. Chop wood, carry water, try again tomorrow.

fallen: Heh... timber...
Leave the axe... someone'll need it.
Tell the camp... I didn't miss the last one.

normal: My mount's stepping lighter. Or I'm sitting better. Either way, we're faster.
Steady progress. A cavalier should be nothing if not steady.
I'd salute, but my mount would take it as a signal to charge.
The drill-masters would be proud. Mine would be surprised.
A lance is only as good as the ride behind it. Both of us improved.
Every day in the saddle is a day the ground can't catch me.
Point the charge, {leader}. We're better for it than we were yesterday.
perfect: Lance, seat, and mount, all at once. Even the old oaths wouldn't ask more.
Every stride, every thrust, better. I think my mount knew before I did.
Better at everything. I suspect my mount of doing half the work.
blank: Nothing? My mount improved, at least. I'll ride on its merits.
Steady means steady. Not every day's a gallop.
The drill yard would call that discipline. I'd call it a trot.

fallen: Take my mount home... it knows the way.
The oath... I never swore it. Wish I had.
Unhorsed... how embarrassing.

normal: Steadier draw. The arrow was gone before I felt it leave.
Keep them at arm's length, {leader}, and then some. I'll handle the rest.
My hands stopped shaking between shots. That's new.
One more quiver's worth of practice. The crown owes me for this one.
I can hear the string sing a little truer now.
Close in, I'm useless. At range, I'm getting frightening.
The wind's easier to read today. Or I'm better at reading it.
perfect: Everything? Even my footwork? Don't let them close in to test it.
Sharper eyes, steadier arm, quicker hands. The yeomanry will hear of this.
Every arrow in the quiver just got better. Including me.
blank: Missed the mark on that one. Not the first time. I'll nock another.
Nothing. Well, I've still got two hands and a string.
A quiet day at the butts. They happen.

fallen: They got... too close.
Keep the bow... the string's new.
One more arrow... just one.

normal: The words come easier. Faster. Slightly more on fire.
My tutors said I'd understand eventually. Eventually is today.
I've added a footnote to my own soul. It seems to have held.
Stronger spells, same paper-thin robes. Stand in front of me, {leader}. Please.
The fire listens better now. I try not to wonder what else is listening.
Another chapter understood. The academy would charge tuition for this.
My fingers stopped smoking afterward. That means control, I'm told.
perfect: All of me improved. Even my arms. I'm going to need a new theory.
Everything grew at once. There must be a formula. I will find it.
Remarkable. I've read of days like this, footnoted as unlikely.
blank: I learned nothing. Which, academically, is still a finding.
A setback. My notes will call it an unexpected plateau.
The book stayed shut today. It happens to the best of us, and to me.

fallen: I hadn't... finished the chapter.
Should have... worn thicker robes.
The words... they're going quiet.

normal: The staff hums warmer now. More of them will get up again.
I can't strike them, but I can outlast them. That's a kind of fight.
Prayers come quicker. I needed them to, today.
The temple taught me to mend. The road taught me to mend fast.
Keep me behind the lines, {leader}. I'll keep the lines alive.
Stronger mending, steadier hands. Someone bring me the wounded.
Every bandage I tie is a little tighter than the last.
perfect: Stronger arms as well? Don't hand me an axe. I'd only hold it wrong.
Every prayer answered at once. I'm grateful, and a little frightened.
Such a blessing. I'll assume it's meant for the wounded, not for me.
blank: Nothing. Then the goddess needs me as I am. Very well.
No change. The wounded won't mind; they never ask about me.
Patience is a virtue. I have been extremely virtuous today.

fallen: Who... who will heal me?
Don't grieve, {leader}. Just... keep the others standing.
I'm sorry... I couldn't mend this one.

normal: Lighter fingers, quicker feet. Mind your purses, everyone.
Found a better way through that lock. And through that officer's coat.
Faster than yesterday. Not that anyone saw me yesterday.
Every lock I open teaches me something. Mostly about the owner.
Nobody saw me get stronger. That's how I like it.
You watch the fog, {leader}. I'll watch the strongboxes.
Armor's still a problem. Everything else, less and less.
perfect: I got better at everything. Who did I rob for this?
Every bit of me improved. I'd say I stole it, but I'd remember.
A whole haul, and I didn't even pick a lock. Suspicious.
blank: Came away empty-handed. Don't tell anyone; it's bad for my name.
Nothing. Can't steal from yourself, apparently. I tried.
Some jobs don't pay. You still leave through the window.

fallen: Guess I... couldn't slip this one.
Check my pockets, {leader}... some of it's yours.
Should've... run faster.

normal: My feet remember more steps than yesterday. Want to see?
A dancer grows the way a song does. One verse at a time.
Lighter on my toes. Arrows will find that disappointing.
Watch me, {leader}. I'll give them one more reason to keep going.
The rhythm's in my bones now. Even the marching sounds like music.
I don't swing a blade. I just make sure the ones who do keep swinging.
The stage was smaller than this field. The applause was quieter too.
perfect: Every step landed perfectly. I'd take a bow, but the enemy's watching.
All of me, better. Is this what the troupe meant by stage fever?
A flawless performance! Nobody clap; they'll hear us.
blank: I missed a step. Everyone does. We dance it again.
Nothing new today. Some nights the house is empty.
Same old routine. Well, it's a crowd favorite.

fallen: Don't stop... keep them marching.
The last dance... wasn't mine to finish.
Did they... clap?

normal: My pegasus chose well, {leader}. Today I proved it.
The wind feels thinner up here. Or I'm cutting through it cleaner.
Faster wings, steadier lance. Archers, take note, and then take cover.
The sky legions promised me nothing but weather. They were wrong.
Every flight I land in one piece, I come down a little stronger.
She's feeling it too. Her wings beat like she's proud of me.
Still scared of arrows. Less scared of everything else.
perfect: Stronger, faster, steadier, all of it. My pegasus is preening.
Everything improved! Even my nerve around archers. Almost.
I've never flown like that. I'm not sure my feet should touch ground again.
blank: A calm day aloft. Nothing gained, nothing shot off. I'll take it.
Nothing. My pegasus gave me a look I won't soon forget.
Some days the wind just won't lift you. You wait for tomorrow's.

fallen: Arrows... always the arrows.
Let her fly home... don't let her see me.
The sky... it's so far away now.

normal: My wyvern bit me less today. That's how you know you're getting stronger.
Every clan elder said I'd never break one. Now look at us.
Scales thicker, grip tighter. Mages still worry me.
The mountains raise you hard. The war's raising me harder.
We hit like a rockslide now. A rockslide with opinions.
Stronger again. The clan will raise my price, you watch.
Point us downhill, {leader}. Everything is downhill from up here.
perfect: Every scale and sinew stronger. The elders will say I stole a better wyvern.
Even my wits sharpened. My wyvern hates that. It was the clever one.
Everything at once. I half expect the beast to demand a cut.
blank: Nothing. I think my wyvern ate the lesson.
A stubborn day. The beast and I had that in common.
No change. In the mountains we call that surviving.

fallen: Magic... always finds the gaps.
Don't let them... sell my wyvern, {leader}.
Fly home, you ugly brute... I loved you.

normal: Worth more than I was this morning. I'll be renegotiating.
Better at the trade. The trade being staying alive.
No weak spots, no surprises. That's what you're paying for.
Stronger, quicker, still cheap. Tell the paymaster before I do.
Every contract teaches you something. This one keeps teaching.
Fought for worse commanders than you, {leader}. None better, yet.
Good steel, good pay, good day. Two out of three, anyway.
perfect: Everything grew. My rates are going up. Nothing personal.
Years in the trade and I've never had a day this good.
Everything at once. In my trade, that means someone's about to cheat you.
blank: Nothing. Still, a contract's a contract, {leader}. I'll show up tomorrow.
Paid the same, learned nothing. Most jobs are like that.
Don't mention this to the guild. My reputation is my wages.

fallen: Keep the pay, {leader}... it's yours now.
Should've... read the contract closer.
Worth it. Tell them it was worth it.

normal: Every cut is closer to the one my master never managed.
The fight's over before they know it began. I'm getting quicker at that.
I barely had to swing. That's the whole art, in the end.
The blade grows heavier with every life. My arm doesn't mind.
Leave the long fights to others. Mine end in one breath.
I sense the opening before they give it. Unsettling, even for me.
Stand back, {leader}. The sword is having a very good day.
perfect: Perfect form, from heel to edge. I may never draw carelessly again.
Nothing wasted, nothing lacking. My old master would weep, then check my blade.
Too perfect. A true master distrusts a day like this. I'll keep practicing.
blank: Nothing new. A master learns that the last inch is the longest.
Stillness. Also a lesson, if a dull one.
Even masters have days when the sword teaches nothing.

fallen: A perfect cut... just not mine.
I wasn't afraid, {leader}. Remember that.
Sheathe it for me... gently.
promotion: I'm not afraid anymore. I only just noticed. When did that happen?
The school said a master never needs a second cut. Now I understand why.
Swordmaster. Let's see whether the title can keep up with me.

normal: Hit me. Please. I've gotten so much better at answering.
I let them lead the dance. I always end it.
The halls say a duelist is a question with a sharp answer.
Steadier on the counter. They'll learn not to start things with me.
Swing, parry, reply. The rhythm's nearly perfect now.
Every cut I take teaches me where the next one's coming from.
Challenge accepted. Not that anyone issued one. I accept anyway.
perfect: Every answer quicker, every guard firmer. The halls would ring for this.
Flawless. Someone send a challenge; I'd hate to waste it.
All of it improved. I can already hear the hall masters calling it luck.
blank: No improvement. I demand a rematch with myself.
A drawn bout. It happens, even in the best halls.
Nothing. A duelist bows anyway.

fallen: Good bout... good bout.
I yield. First time... last time.
You struck true... well played.
promotion: The halls taught me to wait for their mistake. Now I wait with a lance, too.
Duelist. Come on, then. Take your swing. I insist.
Every hall has a ring. From today, wherever I stand is one.

normal: Another layer of iron, inside and out.
They broke three blades on me today. I'm keeping count.
I don't march. I arrive. Eventually.
The capital's walls could learn a thing or two from me.
Stronger. Slower too, probably, but who could tell?
Every blow they land now feels like weather. Unpleasant, and passing.
Place me in the gap, {leader}. The gap will stop being a problem.
perfect: Swifter as well? A general who runs. The manuals will need rewriting.
Everything improved. I feel like a castle that grew another keep.
All of it? Check the plate for a hole. Nothing's this generous with me.
blank: Unchanged. Unmoved. Unbothered. As a general should be.
Nothing new. Fortresses rarely grow; they simply endure.
No change. The armor didn't notice, and neither did I.

fallen: Fortresses... do fall. Who knew.
Hold the gap, {leader}... without me.
Help me with the buckles... I want to breathe.
promotion: They promoted me to fortress. The duties haven't changed much.
General. I suppose now I'm the stone they were wanting.
Heavier plate, heavier axe, heavier burden. I'll carry all three.

normal: The mount carries me easier. Either I'm stronger or it's resigned.
Heavy as a knight, quick as a cavalier. Almost. Getting there.
Ride in, hit hard, ride out. Just like the drills, only louder.
Every charge I survive, I'm a little more armor and a little more rider.
The ground shakes a bit more when I pass now. I've been noticing.
An axe, a sword, a lance, and a mount. I'm running out of hands.
Stronger again. My saddle-maker sends his regrets.
perfect: Armor, arms, and speed, all improved. {leader}, I'm the whole cavalry now.
Everything grew. My poor mount deserves a medal.
Stronger and faster at once. Suspicious. Someone weigh me.
blank: Nothing. Heavy things change slowly.
No progress. At least I'm no heavier. The mount will be pleased.
Same as before. Still a wall on four legs. I'll take it.

fallen: Get my mount clear... it's done enough.
Too heavy... to run. Always was.
Rode in... didn't ride out.
promotion: Less plate, more mount. My knees have never been happier.
A wall that arrives on time. I think I'll like this rank.
Great Knight. My mount's face says it was hoping for a smaller one.

normal: Hit harder today than a falling tree. And I've been under falling trees.
Axe for the near ones, bow for the rest. It's simpler than it sounds.
Another war, another scar, another inch of muscle.
They keep sending tougher enemies. I keep getting tougher.
I don't know what the war wants from me. I keep giving it more.
My arms feel like old roots. Hard to cut, harder to shift.
Keep pointing, {leader}. I'll keep swinging until you stop.
perfect: All of me, bigger and better. I'll need a larger axe to match.
Even my aim? The bow's going to be a problem for someone now.
Everything, at once. Where was this when I was chopping wood for coin?
blank: Nothing. Strange... I'd swear I've swung this exact swing before.
Didn't grow an inch. Good thing I was already enormous.
Same old me. The axe didn't seem to mind.

fallen: Took a whole war... to get me.
Bury me... somewhere with trees.
Not falling... just sitting down a moment.
promotion: Promoted by attrition, they say. Fine. I'm the one still here.
A bow as well? The old camp foreman would never believe this.
Warrior. Axes my whole life, and now they want me to aim. Terrifying.

normal: More strength, more rage. The leash feels thinner.
The more they cut, the clearer everything gets. Is that normal?
I remembered my own name through the whole fight. Progress.
Bleeding makes me better. Please don't take that as an invitation.
Every wound is a drumbeat. Today's song was very loud.
The school warned me the red would get easier to find.
Stronger. The axe felt like a feather. The enemy didn't agree.
perfect: Everything? Even my calm? Now I'm truly worried.
All of it grew. The rage, the reach, the restraint. Mostly the rage.
I feel magnificent. That's usually when somebody gets hurt.
blank: Nothing grew but the anger. It doesn't count, they tell me.
Blank. Good. Something has to stay the same in here.
I learned nothing. I broke a table about it. Now I'm fine.

fallen: Finally... it's quiet.
Let go of the leash, {leader}... I'm done.
More... I had more.
promotion: The school didn't choose me. It just finally admitted what it saw.
They've handed me the leash. I'll try to hold my end.
Berserker. The quiet in my head has stopped arguing with the noise.

normal: The oaths grow easier to keep as the arm grows stronger.
Every ride forward is a promise kept. I've kept several today.
Steady, like the old knights. Better, maybe; they didn't have my mount.
The strong must serve. I'm getting strong enough to serve properly.
My mount and I are one creature on a good day. Today was good.
No weak side, no wasted motion. The drills finally make sense.
Ride where you need me, {leader}. The oath goes where I go.
perfect: Every virtue strengthened at once. I'll try to remain humble. Try.
All of me, better. Surely some knight of old is riding with me.
Everything improved. I must have kept a vow I don't remember making.
blank: Nothing new. An oath kept is its own reward. Mostly.
No change. A paladin doesn't sulk. I am simply reflecting nobly.
Steady as ever. Some call it stagnation; I call it bearing.

fallen: I kept it... the whole oath... didn't I?
Look after my mount. It was always the better knight.
Serve them... that was the part... they left out.
promotion: I'll swear the old oath. All of it. Even the part they stopped reading aloud.
Paladin. The saddle feels the same, but the weight on it doesn't.
Sword at my hip, lance in hand, and {leader} to serve. Let's be worthy of all three.

normal: The spells come colder and quicker. I've stopped asking why.
Lance or tome, they fall the same. I'm getting better at choosing.
My mount shies from the words less now. That, or it's given up.
I strike first and hard. Wherever the power comes from, it answers.
The shadows on the pages moved again. I think they approve.
Stronger in flesh and in the other thing. Don't ask about the other thing.
Point me at them, {leader}. Something in the tome wants to meet them.
perfect: Everything, even my faith in this. That's the part that worries me.
All of me strengthened. I'll pretend I didn't hear the whisper that came with it.
Perfect. I've read that power this clean is always a loan.
blank: Nothing. The tome went quiet today. I almost miss it.
No change. Perhaps the dark is rationing me.
Unchanged. I'll try reading louder.

fallen: Was it... worth the pages?
The dark... it's warmer than I thought.
Help me down... I'd rather go standing.
promotion: The court circle's lessons, at last. I won't ask the price. Not yet.
Lance in one hand, tome in the other. My mount looks nervous.
Dark Knight. They say the title is earned. I think it was lent.

normal: One breath, one shot. The breath keeps getting shorter.
They hid in the trees. The trees didn't help.
Patience is a muscle. Mine's gotten enormous.
The string and I finally agree on everything.
I've started counting heartbeats between shots. Theirs, not mine.
Farther, steadier, quieter. If they hear it, I did it wrong.
Give me a wall and a morning, {leader}. I'll give you an empty field.
perfect: Everything. Even my nerve. There's no shot I'd refuse now.
Every fiber tuned like a good string. Don't touch me; I might twang.
Improved in every way. Somewhere, a target just felt a chill.
blank: Nothing. A sniper waits. I'm good at waiting.
No change. Still hit what I aimed at. That's the only measure.
Nothing. The wind moved. I didn't.

fallen: Didn't see... that one coming.
My name... someone should... know it.
Tell the wall... I'm off duty.
promotion: Sniper. So now nobody learns my name. Suits me.
No bush, no wall, no fog. Nowhere left for them to stand.
They handed me the rank and looked away. I understand the custom now.

normal: Shoot, turn, ride. I'm getting the order right more often.
My mount knows the drill now. It swings wide before I even ask.
The sword's for when they catch me. They're catching me less.
Every opening strike lands cleaner. The first word is the one that counts.
The marches teach you to hit and not be there. I'm learning fast.
Loosed from the saddle and still hit the buckle. Well, near it.
I'll start the argument, {leader}. You finish it.
perfect: Everything! Arrows, steel, stride. I could pick a fight with a regiment.
All of me, faster and sharper. The open road feels too small now.
Improved in every way. I'll celebrate once I've ridden somewhere safe.
blank: Nothing. Rode in, rode out, learned nothing. Classic skirmish.
No change. Tomorrow I'll ride faster and hope it catches up.
Well. That was a wasted ride.

fallen: Should've... kept riding.
Caught me... standing still. Stupid.
Let my mount run... it always wanted to.
promotion: A bow and a saddle. Now I can shoot someone and be gone before they complain.
Bow Knight. Arrive, argue, leave. I've been practicing the arguing.
Finally, legs that never tire. They're just not mine.

normal: I understand another page. I'm less sure the page understands me.
Burn it, mend it, study it. My days have become wonderfully full.
My spells have stopped needing words. That's either mastery or a warning.
The staff and the tome share a shelf now. They're getting along.
Every lesson opens three more questions. Delightful.
Stronger in the mind. My knees remain unconvinced.
Ask me anything, {leader}. I'm nearly certain I know it now.
perfect: Everything, all at once. I'll need a new volume just for today.
Improved in all respects. I'll write a treatise, and you're all in it.
Better in every respect. I've rechecked my reasoning twice. It holds, alarmingly.
blank: Nothing. I've been reading the same page for an hour, apparently.
No new insight. Even a library has an empty shelf.
Unchanged. The truth is patient; so am I, reluctantly.

fallen: So much... left unread.
Take my notes... the margins matter most.
At last... I'll learn what's past the final page.
promotion: Sage. The academy's word for someone who found the library's back door.
Healing as well as burning. I suppose that's balance, of a sort.
I read past the last approved page. It was worth it.

normal: Every wound I give, I take a little back. I'm getting hungrier.
The book feels warm in my hands. It never used to.
Stronger. Long fights suit me now; they're a meal with courses.
I've stopped counting the pages I've read. The pages count me.
My wounds close as theirs open. I no longer find that strange.
The whispers explained something new last night. I took notes.
Keep the fight going, {leader}. I only get better the longer it lasts.
perfect: Everything strengthened. The tome looks fuller as well. Coincidence.
All of me, flourishing. I don't dare ask what went hungry for it.
Magnificent. I'll assume nothing will be collected later.
blank: Nothing. The book kept it for itself this time.
Unchanged. Even darkness takes a day of rest.
No gain. I'll read deeper. That always works, in the end.

fallen: The book... finally closes.
It fed on me... and I let it.
Don't open it. Whatever you do... don't open it.
promotion: The pages past the end are reading me back. I'm told that's the promotion.
Warlock. The book fed on me for years. Now it's my turn to eat.
I never asked for this power. I just never stopped turning pages.

normal: My wounds knit on their own now. It's a strange grace.
The light burns brighter for the wicked and warmer for the rest.
I spent years mending. It seems I may now also correct.
Every prayer said in a burning field counts double. I'm sure of it.
My vestments are ruined, but my faith is in better shape than ever.
The temples are empty, so the temple walks with me.
Rest a moment, {leader}. I've light enough for everyone now.
perfect: Every gift at once. The goddess must be making up for the war.
All of me strengthened. I'll resist the pride. I'll resist it loudly.
Perfection. I'm searching my conscience for whatever I've missed.
blank: No change. Humility is also a lesson, and I've had plenty.
Nothing. The light is testing me. Well, I'll pass.
Unchanged. The wounded still need bandages. Onward.

fallen: I forgive them... I think I do.
The light is... so close now.
Heal the others first, {leader}. Always the others first.
promotion: They say a bishop carries the whole temple. I'll carry what's left of it.
Mercy in one hand, judgment in the other. I'll try not to confuse them.
The light answers when I strike now. I pray I only ask it rightly.

normal: I mend the ones beside me and bury the ones in front.
My prayers got louder. So did my axe.
Stand close. My presence keeps you whole now, apparently.
Stronger faith, stronger arms. The two turned out to be related.
I've learned to heal with blood on my hands. The goddess understands.
The front line is where the wounded are. So that's where I pray.
A good day's work: two healed, three felled, one hymn sung.
perfect: Blessed in body and spirit. The abbot would be proud and slightly alarmed.
Everything improved. I'll offer thanks, then offer violence.
All of it at once! Either a miracle, or I finally prayed correctly.
blank: Nothing. The spirit is willing and the axe is patient.
No change. I'll meditate on it, after I've hit something.
Unchanged. A monk learns to accept the empty bowl.

fallen: Stand together, {leader}... I can't hold you now.
Put the axe down... pray for me instead.
I broke my vow... it was worth it.
promotion: A staff for the wounded, an axe for whoever wounded them. Balance.
The abbot always said I prayed with my shoulders. Now it's official.
Battle Monk. I have taken a vow of peace. It's temporarily suspended.

normal: Quieter. Quicker. Closer before they know I'm there.
One strike is all it takes. I'm getting better at finding which one.
I never raise my voice. I've never had to.
Every shadow knows me a little better now.
They'll say they saw nothing. They'll be telling the truth.
The blade and I have an arrangement: it doesn't miss, I don't hesitate.
Give me a name, {leader}. Just the one.
perfect: Perfect. That troubles me. Perfection leaves a trail.
Everything sharpened. I'll try not to enjoy it where anyone can see.
Stronger in every way. Somewhere, somebody's luck just ran out.
blank: Nothing. As far as anyone knows, I was never here.
No change. I'll keep it out of the ledger.
Unchanged. Silence is also a skill.

fallen: Nobody... will write this down. Good.
Never... heard them coming. Funny.
Don't say my name... there isn't one.
promotion: Assassin. There'll be no record of this, of course.
The empire pays for this work and never writes it down. Neither will I.
A bow too? Now I can end them from the next room over.

normal: Faster hands, cleaner blessings. A very productive sermon.
Patched your wound and lifted a purse on the way back. Efficient.
I swear the staff works better after it's been stolen.
Quicker than a blink. Please check your belongings.
The goddess forgives thieves. I've made sure of it, personally.
Every door opens eventually. So does every heart, and every pocket.
A fair trade, {leader}: your safety for their valuables.
perfect: Blessed and burgled at once. A perfect day on both sides of the altar.
All of me improved. I'll light a candle. Somebody else's candle.
Flawless. I know flawless when I see it; it's usually a forgery.
blank: Nothing? I'll call it a tithe.
No gain. Even a trickster gets tricked.
Unchanged. I checked my pockets twice. Nothing new in either.

fallen: Pray for me, {leader}... then check my sleeves.
I never... really believed. I hope I was wrong.
Last trick... didn't work. Sorry.
promotion: Took the vows. Kept the lockpicks. Nobody said I had to choose.
Trickster. A priest of the open door, and every door is open to me.
I heal you, I rob them. Everyone leaves happier, mostly.

normal: I've learned a new verse. It's about you, if you're not careful.
Another song remembered. Another village that won't be forgotten.
The marchers hum along now. That's how you know it worked.
My voice carries farther. So does the healing.
Musical staves, healing staves. I'm fluent in both now.
Every checkpoint we pass, I hide one more old song in the baggage.
Sing with me, {leader}. The enemy hates harmony.
perfect: A standing ovation from my own body. Every part applauding.
Everything improved! I'll need a longer ballad about myself.
Perfect pitch, perfect step. Mind the encore; I'll want one.
blank: Nothing new. Even the best songs have a quiet bar.
No change. I'll write a ballad about persistence. It'll be short.
Unchanged. A rest is part of the music too.

fallen: Sing it... for me. The last verse.
Don't let... the songs stop, {leader}.
Encore... no. Just the once.
promotion: Bard. I'll carry the songs past every gate the banners can't cross.
A song for the tired and a staff for the hurt. My repertoire grows.
The troupe would be proud. They'd also want a share.

normal: Faster through the clouds. Even the storms can't keep up.
Grace is a weapon if you swing it right. I swing it daily.
Alone in the sky, I'm hardest to touch. I'm getting very hard to touch.
The archers below look smaller every day.
My mount's wingbeat and my heartbeat keep time now.
Wherever hope is thinnest, that's where I land. Busy days, lately.
I'll be where you need me, {leader}, before you know you need me.
perfect: Faster, stronger, surer. The sky feels like mine for the first time.
Everything improved. I won't tell my mount; it'll be unbearable.
A flawless flight. I'm scanning the horizon for what it's warning me about.
blank: Nothing. Even a falcon has to glide sometimes.
No change. The wind was against me today. It usually loses.
Unchanged. I'll try again once the clouds clear.

fallen: Catch the wind... for me.
The escort's broken... get them clear.
I landed... where hope was thinnest. It was here.
promotion: The commission's colors. I'll outfly the weather and still land on time.
A sword at my side, a lance in hand, and the whole sky to argue with.
Falcon Knight. My mount already acted like one. Now I'm allowed to.

normal: They flinch when my shadow crosses them. They should.
Every beat of those wings says the same thing: we were here first.
My wyvern's teeth and my axe agree on most things.
The mountains taught me to be heavy. The sky taught me when to drop.
Stronger. The beast and I don't talk about feelings, but we both felt it.
Nobody attacks me twice. They remember the landing.
Just say where, {leader}. The shadow gets there before we do.
perfect: Stronger in every way. My wyvern roared about it for an hour.
Everything improved. The clans will be telling this story wrong for years.
All of it. I'm starting to see why the old kings feared us.
blank: Nothing. My wyvern snorted at me. I'd rather it hadn't.
No change. The mountain didn't move today either.
Unchanged. A lord doesn't need to grow. Just to land.

fallen: The shadow... is lifting.
Don't let it... grieve alone. Wyverns remember.
Down... first time I've landed badly.
promotion: Wyvern Lord. The clans crown no kings. They just step aside when I land.
An axe as well? My wyvern's grin just got wider.
Bigger wings, bigger shadow. Arguments below will be shorter now.

normal: The wounds close quicker while I'm fighting. Handy trick, that.
Veterans don't get faster. We just waste less.
Every fight teaches you where not to be. I'm rarely there anymore.
Sword or axe, doesn't matter. The hand knows the work.
I've buried better soldiers than me. So I keep getting better.
No gaps left to find. They're welcome to keep looking.
I'll go first, {leader}. That's what the word means.
perfect: Everything, all at once? I'll try to be worthy of it.
A day like this is a gift at my age. I'll put it to work.
All of me improved. The ranks will make a song of this. I'll hate it.
blank: Nothing. Doesn't matter. I still show up.
No change. I've had worse days. I've had much worse.
Same as before. The soldiers won't notice, and that's how it should be.

fallen: Don't... make a song of it.
It was never... about the name.
Keep them together, {leader}. That's all a hero does.
promotion: Hero. The soldiers gave me that word. It's heavier than any armor.
Command offered me a medal. The ranks gave me a name. I'll keep the name.
An axe too. Good. A hero shouldn't turn down honest work.

normal: Every trail reads easier now. The enemy walks like a lost deer.
Swamp, thicket, scree. My feet don't care anymore.
I can smell the rain an hour out now. Useful, in a war.
The war drafted my aim. It didn't know it got my patience free.
I hunted rabbits to feed my family. The quarry's bigger now.
Quiet steps, steady hands. The forest taught me; the war is grading.
I'll find the way through, {leader}. There's always a deer path.
perfect: Keener eyes, surer feet, stronger draw. A season's growth in a day.
Everything improved. The forest must have taken a liking to me.
In the woods, feeling this lucky usually means you're the bait.
blank: Came home with an empty bag. Every hunter does, now and then.
No change. The deer don't grow every season either.
Unchanged. The woods don't hurry, so neither do I.

fallen: Feed... the town. Someone has to.
Lost the trail... that's all.
Bury me under the trees. I'll know the way.
promotion: Hunter. The woods have been calling me back for years.
No more fighting for the highest bidder. Now I track, and I wait.
A bow again. My family would say I finally came to my senses.

steady: Slow and sure. It's kept me upright this long.
I don't rush. I don't break. That's the whole trick.
Let them hit me. I'll still be here when they tire.
Nothing fancy. One more step, then another.
nimble: Light on my feet, and lighter every day.
They can't hit what isn't there anymore.
I barely touch the ground now. Feels right.
Quick feet, quicker exits. Both have saved my life.
hardy: Takes more than that to put me down. A lot more.
I've been stabbed worse. Somewhere. Once. I think.
Bruised is just another word for alive.
Tough as old boot leather, and about as pretty.
keen: Sharper eyes, steadier hands. I see the gaps now.
I don't waste a blow. Never have.
There's always an opening. You just have to look.
Missing is a habit. I've broken it.
brawny: Not quick, but when I land it, it stays landed.
More muscle. My legs are complaining, but my arms are thrilled.
Why dodge when you can simply hit harder?
I'll get there. Slowly. And then they'll regret it.
clever: The formulas come easier now. The headaches, less so.
I understand it now. Mostly. The rest I'll bluff.
A good mind is the only weapon that sharpens itself.
I studied the pattern. It studied me back. I won.
lucky: I keep waiting for my luck to run out. It keeps not running.
Somebody up there likes me. I'd love to know why.
Found a coin on the road this morning. Today's been like that.
Can't believe that worked. I never can. It always does.
cornered: I fight best with my back to the wall. Ask anyone who's pinned me.
Bleeding makes me clearer. Don't ask me why.
Hurt me. Go on. That's when it gets interesting.
Nothing sharpens you like nearly dying.
vigorous: Fresh legs, full lungs. Let's go before the ache sets in.
I'm best in the first hour. Point me at something early.
Up with the sun and glad of it.
Keep me rested and I'll hit like a landslide.
lone_wolf: Give me room. I work better where no one's watching.
I grow best alone. Fight best alone, too.
Nothing personal. I just like the quiet between us.
Stand back a few paces. For both our sakes.
woodsman: Stronger. I'd feel it more under a proper canopy.
Too much open ground in this war. I miss the pines.
Put me in the trees and watch what I can do now.
The forest taught me patience. The war's teaching me the rest.
studious: I took notes. Page forty. Would you like to see?
Every fight's a lesson. I keep a ledger of them.
I've been studying the veterans. They don't know it.
Another chapter learned. My handwriting's getting worse, though.
lazy: Stronger without trying. The drills were a waste, clearly.
Must we train tomorrow? I've already improved today.
I'll master this someday. No rush. None at all.
Wake me when there's something worth getting up for.
reckless: Put me up front. Every time. That's where I grow.
Caution's for people who plan to grow old.
Let me charge next time. I'll try to wait for the order.
Stronger! Now let's see how deep into them I can get.
quick_study: Oh, I get it now. That was quick, wasn't it?
Watched it done once. That's usually enough.
I pick things up fast. Put them down faster, sometimes.
One more lesson learned. What's next? Show me.

HP: I can take a harder hit now. Please don't test that.
My heart beats slower and stronger. Like a war drum.
More blood in me than yesterday. Try spilling it all.
I could march two days on this breath.
Something in my chest has set like mortar.
STR: My arms feel like they were swapped with a smith's.
Nearly tore the tent pole out of the ground this morning.
Heavier blows. The sparring post has filed a complaint.
My grip's gone iron. Check my hands for rust.
Lifted the supply cart alone. Don't tell the quartermaster.
MAG: Why do my fingers tingle? What have I been eating?
The air hums when I breathe now. That's normal, right?
Candles lean toward me when I pass. I'd like them to stop.
My blood runs bright. I can feel the old words in it.
Something answers when I call now, from deeper than before.
SKL: My hands know the work before my head does.
I can see the seams in their guard now.
Threaded a needle in the dark last night. First try.
Every motion trimmed down to what matters.
My aim's gone quiet. No wasted breath, no wasted strike.
SPD: I can hear the arrows coming now. Plenty of time.
My feet are faster than my thoughts. Hope the thoughts catch up.
The world slowed down. Or I sped up. Either way.
Caught a fly out of the air. Let it go, of course.
They swing, I'm gone. I'm starting to enjoy that.
DEF: Blades glance off me now. Rude of them.
My skin feels like it's been through a tannery.
Hit me. Go on. I barely noticed that last one.
Bruises don't take hold the way they used to.
I've become a wall with opinions.
RES: Spells feel thinner now, like cold rain.
Magic slides off me. I felt it try.
My blood's gone stubborn. Hexes can't find a grip.
The old words can't get their hooks in me anymore.
Something in me says no to the dark, and means it.
LCK: Found a four-leaf clover. Then another. Then a third.
Fortune's walking beside me. Hope it keeps pace.
I can feel the dice rolling my way before they land.
A crow dropped a coin at my feet. Omen or tip?
Arrows keep finding the soldier next to me. Sorry, friend.

10: Halfway there. The hard part's behind me. Probably.
No recruit anymore. The new ones salute me by accident.
Seasoned. That's what they call it when you survive long enough.
Half a master. The other half is going to hurt.
20: There's nothing left this trade can teach me. What now?
The top of the mountain. The view is mostly more mountains.
Mastered. My old drill sergeant would've wept. Or shouted.
I've taken everything this craft had to give. Every scrap.
This is as far as this road goes. I'll need a new road.
extended: Past the summit and still climbing. Where does this end?
They said there was a ceiling. I must have missed it.
Beyond what I was trained for. Beyond what anyone was.
No manual covers this. I'm writing my own.

skills: {skill}. I've been reaching for that for months.
So that's {skill}. My hands knew before I did.
Add {skill} to the list of things they should fear.
{skill}! I'd hoped, but I never dared say it aloud.
{skill}. The veterans said it would come. It came.
Something clicked. They call it {skill}, I'm told.
dejaVu: I've felt this exact ache before. In this exact shoulder.
Strange. I know the next stone on this road. I've never been here.
This strength feels returned, not earned. Odd, isn't it?
I dreamed I'd learned this already. The dream ended badly.
The same crow, the same field. Why do I always remember the crow?
Have I thanked you for this before, {leader}? It feels like I have.

perfect: Every thread pulled taut.
The weave tightens, stitch by stitch.
A thread spun strong, end to end.
Nothing wasted. Nothing held back.
Growth in every limb at once.
The kind of day soldiers lie about.
All of it, all at once.
Whatever comes next, they're ready.
blank: The thread barely stirred.
The loom paused, and waited.
Not every thread catches.
A long march. Little to show for it.
Some days only teach patience.
Mud, rain, and not much else.
Still alive. That counts for something.
The work goes on, unrewarded.

normal: Stronger. Good. That's one more of them I can stand in front of.
A little better today. The banner won't notice, but I will.
Whatever I gained, it belongs to the ones who kept me alive long enough to gain it.
I'll never be the finest blade here. I only need to be the one that stays.
Stronger, I think. Ask me again after I trip over the banner pole.
Kira says I'm improving. She said it slowly, so I think she meant it.
Every march teaches me something. Today, how much I still don't know.
Good. Now I can carry a little more of what we're all carrying.
The banner is no lighter. My arms are just getting used to it.
One step better. Everyone behind me, take it with me.
I felt that settle in, like a strap finally buckled right.
Sera saw a lord in me once. I'm still growing into her vision.
Better than yesterday. I'll count that, right after I count all of you.
The village smith would laugh to see me now. Then he'd check my grip.
perfect: Everything at once? I didn't earn that alone. Whose prayer was that?
I feel like a lord out of a song. Don't tell anyone; they'll expect it every time.
That's what it feels like when an army stands behind you. All of it at once.
Every part of me, sharper. Someone stood close enough to lend me their luck.
If I'd known it could feel like this, I'd have stopped doubting sooner. Maybe.
blank: Nothing. That's fine. The banner doesn't need me grand, only standing.
Not a thing gained. Well, humility. I had plenty of that already.
Some days you only march. Everyone's still here. That's enough.
No better than yesterday. No worse either. I'll take it and keep counting.
Maybe the lesson was meant for someone watching me. Did anyone learn anything?

10: I've come a long way from the border hall. The ones who came with me, further.
Kira says I'm halfway there. She won't say where there is. She never does.
20: I understand it now. When I step forward, the ones beside me step with me.
One more push, together, before they can answer. That's what the banner was for.
Every drill I ever grumbled through was for this: moving as one, one more time.
extended: Small gains now, like adding one more name to a very long roll.
Still learning. The day I stop, somebody should take the banner from me.
A little more. There's always a little more to give them.

promotion: The crown the old kingdom lost. I'll try very hard not to lose it again.
Great Lord. I'd rather they kept calling me Edric, if nobody minds.
A lance too? Someone show me which end goes forward. Rowan, not a word.
I swore this to the ones who never reached this road. It's theirs. I only carry it.

normal: Better position. Same board. Your move, empire.
One tempo gained. They won't feel it until three moves from now.
Sharper. I'd explain how, but you'd only take notes.
Improvement noted. Filed. Already planning around it.
Good. The line I saw this morning just got shorter.
The war colleges taught me patience. The war is teaching me speed.
Every piece improves if you keep it on the board. Even this one.
A small gain. Small gains win long games, and I plan to keep playing.
Edric counts the army by heads. I count it by what it can do. Mine just went up.
There. Now I can see one square further than I could yesterday.
I didn't get stronger. I got more annoying to play against.
Ask me what changed. No. Watch instead; it's more fun.
Progress. The game is still going, which is exactly how I like it.
My instructors said I'd never be patient. They were right, and I'm winning.
perfect: Every line opened at once. I've seen boards like this. I've never been one.
A perfect position. Suspicious. I'm checking it twice.
Everything improved. Someone in the empire just lost a game they don't know about.
Flawless. Don't tell Edric; he'll want to celebrate and it wastes a turn.
All of it, at once. Remind me to never let this board close.
blank: Nothing gained. A quiet move. Quiet moves are still moves.
Hm. A wasted tempo. Fine. I've won from worse.
No change. Good. My opponents will think I've plateaued.
Nothing. I'll call that a feint and pretend it was planned.
Blank. Even I misplay sometimes. Tell no one.

10: The opening's over. The middle game is where I live.
Ten moves deep and I still don't want it to end. Good sign.
20: Stand beside me now and you're worth more. That's not a boast. It's arithmetic.
