Every piece I touch plays better. The colleges called that theory. It isn't.
The endgame, finally. Which means I have to find a way to make it last.
extended: Past the endgame and still finding moves. Nobody taught me this part.
One more small edge. Games like this never truly end if you're careful.
They closed the colleges. I just keep studying.

promotion: Grandmaster. The empire shut the colleges before anyone could award it. I'll take it.
A sword as well? Fine. Some problems don't answer to theory.
Every rank has a final exam. This war's was particularly thorough.
My old instructors should see this. I'd like them to still be alive to see it.

normal: Still standing. A bit taller, maybe.
Stronger. Doesn't bring anyone back. Helps keep the next one off the ledger.
Hm. Twenty years on the border and I'm still learning. Don't tell the young ones.
Better. Good. Less for me to write down tonight.
Something sharpened. Hope it was me and not my temper.
Improving, at my age. Rowan will say it's luck. It's spite.
Harder to kill now. The emperor's going to have to try.
Good. The old knee still clicks, though.
Every scar taught me something. This one was a slow teacher.
Fine. One more thing I'm still good for.
The wardens said you stop growing on the border. You just stop. I didn't.
Steadier. The hands remember the bow better than my head remembers names.
I'll take it. The ground's patient, but I'm more stubborn.
Better. Tell the ledger to wait a bit longer.
perfect: All of it at once? Hm. Somebody up there owes me, and finally paid.
Everything. Haven't felt like this since before the border burned.
Rowan's going to call that luck. Let him. I'll know better.
Whole body's singing. Feels wrong. Feels good. I'll sort it out later.
My wife used to say I'd sharpen up one day. Took a war. She'd laugh.
blank: Nothing. Still standing, though. That's the part that counts.
Not a thing. Some years the harvest doesn't come either.
No change. I've been the same stubborn man since before you were born.
Nothing gained. Nothing lost. I'll take that trade every day.
Blank. Put it in the ledger under 'still here'.

10: Ten notches on the bow, for lessons. The ledger has more notches. Those are names.
Halfway to something. The wardens never told us what came after. Nobody lived.
20: Now I take back what they take, and then I go straight through. About time.
Every name in the ledger is behind this blade now. Every one.
The sun and the moon in one stroke. The old wardens had a word for it. I forget.
extended: Still going. Death keeps misplacing my name.
A little more. At this rate I'll outlive the war and have to find a hobby.
Past where I stopped expecting to be. Still standing. Still counting.

promotion: Vanguard. They usually give this rank to a gravestone. I'll accept it upright.
Axes now, is it. Good. Some doors don't open for arrows.
First name on the breach roster. Fine. I've been first on worse lists.
My family's names are in my ledger. Today I'm adding one more. Mine. Still living.

normal: I feel the threads pull tighter. That's a good sign, I think.
The light sits easier in my hands. It used to shake.
Stronger. I saw this moment once, in a dream. It was smaller then.
One more thread holds. I'll tie it gently.
The visions are quieter today. Maybe I'm louder.
I grow, and the path ahead grows a little clearer.
Better. I promised I would be, on the last thread. Now I've kept it.
The light listens a little more closely. So do I.
Somewhere, the Lieutenant just frowned. I felt it.
Edric keeps telling me I carry too much. Today it's a bit lighter.
I've felt this exact warmth before. Different road, same step.
The order graduated me early. I'm finishing my lessons out here.
Stronger. The dark will have to reach a little further for us.
I see a little further. Not far enough. Never far enough, but further.
perfect: Every thread shining at once. I've never seen the weave so bright.
All of it. I'm afraid to look at it too long, in case it fades.
This is the thread I kept looking for. Please, let it hold.
The light poured in everywhere. I think the goddess still remembers us.
Perfect. The Lieutenant saw every future but this one. I'm sure of it.
blank: Nothing. Some threads are only for walking, not for weaving.
The light was silent. It's allowed to rest. So am I.
No change. I've walked this step before. It's always this quiet.
Nothing gained. But nobody lost. I'll hold on to that.
Still. Not every vision is a gift. This one was a pause.

10: Halfway, if the path is honest. It isn't always.
Ten turns of the weave. I remember every one. I'd rather not.
20: My light goes through their wards now. What it takes from them, it gives back to me.
I don't just see the thread now. I can burn it clean.
All those failed threads... every one taught my hands this. It was not wasted.
extended: Still growing. The weave has no edge I can find.
I keep going past where the visions stop. It's strange to be surprised.
A little more. I've stopped counting the threads. I only count us.

promotion: The order's highest office. The last pages of the liturgy are mine to keep now.
What sleeps, and what wakes it. I swore to both. I hope I'm strong enough.
The Lieutenant serves an emperor. I serve the ones who walk beside me. Remember that.
I've knelt at this rite on other threads. This time I'll stand up and keep walking.

normal: Better! And before anyone says luck: skill. All skill.
The lance is blessed. The improvement is all mine.
Hear that? That's my mount agreeing with me.
Stronger, faster, more handsome. Two of those are guaranteed.
Voss says I improve by accident. I improve on purpose. Loudly.
Fate owed me that one. I'm collecting.
Every charge makes me better. I plan to charge a great deal.
Getting good at this. Well. Better at it. I was already good.
That's the long marches paying off. Also the naps.
My mount carries me further every day. I'd like to think I help.
Improvement! Put it in the chronicle. Spell my name right.
Better aim, same blessing. Try to keep up.
Sharper. Steadier. Somewhere a lance-master is weeping with pride.
Luck doesn't grow like that. Men do. Well, I do.
perfect: EVERYTHING? Voss, look! Tell me that's luck with a straight face.
Perfect. Naturally. I'd like a portrait. On horseback, please.
All of it! Somebody hold my mount; I need to take this in.
Blessed lance, blessed day, blessed me. That's three for three.
Perfect ride, perfect form. I'll be insufferable for weeks. You were warned.
blank: Nothing? Well. Even skill takes a day off.
Hm. My mount improved, I think. One of us did.
Not a thing. Fine. Fate's clearly saving up something enormous.
Nothing gained. Don't tell Voss. He'll just grunt, and I'll know exactly what it means.
Blank. That wasn't luck. That was restraint. I'm being modest for once.

10: Halfway to legend. The first half was the easy part. Mostly the riding.
Ten long marches' worth. My mount deserves a statue. Next to mine.
20: Now when my lance lands, a friend behind me breathes easier. Beat that for luck.
The blessing and I finally ride in step. We still argue about who does the aiming.
I strike, a friend mends. Took me this long to learn a lance could give back.
extended: Still improving. At this point I'm doing it to annoy Voss.
Past the peak and still climbing. Skill, obviously. Luck gets tired.
A little more. My mount's gray at the muzzle. We're both still going.

promotion: Holy Knight! Consecrated and everything. The lance was blessed first, but I caught up.
Magic? In me? Nobody tell my old lance-master. He'd never recover.
One saddle to mend and to end. My mount has no idea what it just signed up for.
I used to joke about the blessing. I think it was listening. Thank you, whoever.

normal: Better. The wind noticed.
Faster on the turn. Good.
The air feels thinner from here. I like it.
Stronger. My mount's pleased. Hard to tell, but it is.
One more ridge I can clear.
Improved. I'll be over the far picket if anyone needs me. Nobody will.
I see a little further now. Mostly more of all of you.
Sharper. The ground below keeps getting smaller.
Hm. Good. Don't make a fuss.
The sky legions called me hopeless in formation. They were right. Look at me now.
Better. Whatever you're feeling about it, feel it quietly.
The wind gives, sometimes. Today it gave.
Growing. Still happier alone. Some things don't change.
Higher, faster, further. The three honest words of my trade.
perfect: All of it. Even the wind is impressed. I've never seen it impressed.
Perfect. I'm going up for a while. Don't wait.
Everything at once. From up here, it looks like the whole sky moved.
Hm. That was perfect. I'll allow one small smile. There.
Everything. My mount did a loop. It doesn't do loops.
blank: Nothing. Calm air. It happens.
Dead wind. We'll catch the next one.
Nothing gained. I've flown through worse weather.
No change. Good. Nobody will come looking.
Nothing. My mount looked disappointed. It's usually right.

10: I've flown every far picket on the border. Coming back is the part I'm still learning.
The legions sent me out alone. Somehow I'm still coming back. Here, to you.
20: Every guard has a thin side. From above, I always see which. Now I strike there.
Armor or ward, whichever is weaker. The sky taught me to look down properly.
I used to see everything and hit what I could. Now I hit what matters.
extended: Still climbing. There's no ceiling up here. I've checked.
A little higher. The ground doesn't miss me.
More. Sometimes I fly past the pickets just to see if the sky ends. Not yet.

promotion: Seraph Knight. The light found me up here. I didn't think anything could.
Light in the hand. Useful at night. And against things that don't bleed.
My pickets aren't just over land now. I'll keep watch over wherever this leads.
I always flew alone. I'm still flying. I just keep circling back to you now.

normal: Sturdier. The back rank may now resume complaining.
Stronger. The wall appreciates your continued support.
Better. I'd tell you how, but it's all in the standing still.
Heavier in the good way. Archers, you may thank me later.
Improved. Please adjust your hiding spots accordingly.
The line holds a little harder now. You're welcome.
Good. Another thing that has to break before you do.
Tougher. Mages, stop peering around me. It's rude.
I felt that. Somewhere, a gate I once guarded is proud of me.
Stronger. Sera says the stone suits me. I've decided that's a compliment.
Better. Still won't move, though. That's the point.
Sharpened. Not in the pointy way. In the stubborn way.
